senses: to die, kill, have one executed
to die (as penalty), be put to death
to die prematurely (by neglect of wise moral conduct)
(Polel) to kill, put to death, dispatch
to be killed, be put to death

strongs.def: to die (literally or figuratively); causatively, to kill
strongs.kjv: [idiom] at all, [idiom] crying, (be) dead (body, man, one), (put to, worthy of) death, destroy(-er), (cause to, be like to, must) die, kill, necro(-mancer), [idiom] must needs, slay, [idiom] surely, [idiom] very suddenly, [idiom] in (no) wise
